prompt: A disease that had millions of dollars raised for on April 20, 1992, was first recognized by the Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in what year?
answer: The disease was **AIDS**, which was first recognized by the CDC in **1981**, when it reported five cases of Pneumocystis pneumonia among previously healthy gay men in Los Angeles.
